sharedRules.name: Armoured Reserve
sharedRules.description:
In missions with Deep Reserves, you may only field one Armoured Reserves Tank Unit, one Tank Unit with Front Armour of 4 or more, or one Aircraft Unit on the table at the start of the game.
Tanks with Armoured Reserve are BattleTanks for the purpose of the Deep Reservesand similar rules. (LFTF)

sharedRules.name: No MG
sharedRules.description: The R-35 (45mm) tank does not have an MG so does not use the R-35 (MG) weapon line.

sharedRules.name: Panzerfaust - Limited 1
sharedRules.description:
Each time this Unit shoots, one of its Teams may shoot as a Panzerfaust rather than its usual weapons.
Each time this Unit rolls To Hit in an assault, one of its Teams may attack with a Panzerfaust rather than its usual weapons.

sharedRules.name: Bazooka Skirts
sharedRules.description: A Tank Team with Bazooka Skirts increases its Side armour to 5 against weapons with Firepower 5+ or 6.

sharedRules.name: HEAT
sharedRules.description: A Team's Armour rating is not increased by +1 if it is more than 16"/40cm away when hit by HEAT weapons.

sharedRules.name: Cavalry
sharedRules.description:
Cavalry Teams are Infantry Teams with the following additional rules:
Cavalry Teams add +1 to the score To Hit when Shooting while mounted. Cavalry Teams are not Concealed and friends cannot shoot over them when stationary in the Open.
Cavalry Teams Move 6"/15cm when Charging into Contact.
Cavalry Teams cannot hit Armoured Tank Teams in Assaults.
Cavalry Teams cannot occupy Foxholes or Buildings while mounted.
Like normal infantry heavy weapons Cavalry Heavy Weapons teams cannot Charge Into Contact.
Cavalry Heavy Weapons teams and Panzerfaust weapons cannot shoot while mounted and must dismount to shoot.

sharedRules.name: Dismount
sharedRules.description:
A Cavalry Team can dismount in the Movement Step as the equivalent Infantry Team armed with the same weapons.
A Cavalry Team that dismounts at the start of the Movement Step can make an Infantry Team Tactical Move. Dismounting, whether the Team makes a Tactical move or not, counts as Movement.
Once dismounted they are Infantry teams and cannot remount for the rest of the game. Dismounted teams lose all the Cavalry rules and move as normal Infantry teams.

sharedRules.name: Infantry Tank
sharedRules.description: R-35 tanks have a Tactical Move of 8"/20cm if Breaking Off in an Assault.

sharedRules.name: Defend the Homeland
sharedRules.description: Romanian Infantry units have an increased Assult rating.
